profile.summary: joelmheim is a Mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in the Moment.js date library, focusing on internationalization, locale-specific date formatting, and unit testing. Their contributions demonstrate strong proficiency in JavaScript ES5/ES6 patterns, functional programming principles, and prototype-based object-oriented design. While their work is primarily frontend-focused (browser/JavaScript), they show deep knowledge of date/time handling and testing methodologies. There is no evidence of experience with modern frontend frameworks (React/Vue), backend systems (Node.js), or TypeScript. Their contributions are highly specialized in legacy JavaScript libraries and date manipulation, with particular strength in CLDR compliance and locale updates.
